sources_considered.why: Shows several firms holding large enterprise shares in mid-2025. Context only.
About the capability gap, not market exclusion; used for a related claim.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic now holds 32% of the enterprise large language model market share by usage, according to a report from Menlo Ventures released on Thursday. OpenAI holds the second-largest market share by usage among enterprises, with 25%.

evidence_items.explanation: In mid-2025, enterprise use was split among several firms with no single winner. This is a snapshot and cannot settle a forecast about 'ever'.

unresolved_gaps: The forecast has no deadline. Any snapshot before the evaluation date cannot show that the race will never become winner-take-all.
